name: Landsat 9
fact: Part of a 50-year record of Earth images used to track forests, farms, cities and fires.

name: PACE
fact: Studies ocean color, tiny plankton, clouds and aerosols.

name: NASA CubeSat Launch Initiative missions
fact: Since 2011, NASA has launched over 150 small CubeSats built by students and universities.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
fact: Has mapped the Moon in detail for over 15 years.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
fact: Has sent back more data than all earlier Mars missions combined.

name: MAVEN
fact: Studies how Mars lost most of its atmosphere to space.

name: Juno
fact: First solar-powered spacecraft to operate at Jupiter, with its electronics inside a titanium radiation vault.

name: Europa Clipper
fact: Uses huge solar arrays and a radiation vault to study the icy moon Europa.

name: Cassini
fact: Orbited Saturn for 13 years and ended with a 'Grand Finale' dive into Saturn in 2017.
